diagnostics.message: kubectl_manifest.karpenter_provisioner creates a Karpenter Provisioner whose `spec.providerRef.name: default` refers to the AWSNodeTemplate named "default" created by kubectl_manifest.karpenter_node_template. Because that reference is a literal string inside yaml_body, Terraform infers no dependency, so the Provisioner can be applied before the AWSNodeTemplate exists and Karpenter has no provider to resolve. Add `depends_on = [kubectl_manifest.karpenter_node_template]` (in addition to the existing dependency on module.eks_blueprints_kubernetes_addons, which only guarantees the CRDs are installed).
